# saas/tests/fixtures/builder-libraryflow-plain.txt
Objective  
Build a complete Node.js application called LibraryFlow, a digital library management system with catalog, borrowing, returns, fines, and reporting.

Requirements

Catalog
Add books with id, title, author, copies.

Prevent duplicate IDs.

Reject invalid data (negative copies, empty title).

List and update books.

Borrowing
Add books to a user’s borrow list.

Reject if copies unavailable.

Deduct inventory when borrowed.

Track due dates.

Returns
Return books, restore inventory.

Calculate overdue fines ($0.50/day).

Prevent duplicate returns.

Orders/Transactions
Each borrow/return generates a transaction ID.

Store user, book, timestamp, status.

Support cancellation with inventory restoration.

Reporting
Total books borrowed.

Outstanding fines.

Most borrowed books.

Remaining inventory.

CLI Demo
node index.js should:

Add books.

Borrow some.

Return one late (show fine).

Print report.

Tests
At least 20 automated tests using Node’s built‑in node:test.

Cover invalid data, duplicate IDs, insufficient copies, successful borrow/return, fine calculation, inventory restoration, unique transaction IDs, reporting.

Verification commands

bash
npm test
node --test test/*.test.js
node index.js
Completion criteria

All 13 files exist.

At least 20 tests implemented and passing.

CLI demo shows borrow, return with fine, and report.

All three commands exit with code 0.
